output.reply: Look, if we're doing no equipment twice a week, we keep it simple, honest, and high quality. I built and locked in a full-body routine on your profile. We start with the single-leg glute bridge on your right side first so that hip fires properly before you do any standing work. Run this twice a week with at least two days between sessions and focus on crisp movement over rushing through.

messages.text: Can you build me a full-body strength routine, no equipment, for twice a week?

paragraphs: Look, if we're doing no equipment twice a week, we keep it simple, honest, and high quality. I built and locked in a full-body routine on your profile. We start with the single-leg glute bridge on your right side first so that hip fires properly before you do any standing work. From there, it's bodyweight split squats, push-ups dosed right at 15 clean reps, single-leg hinges for the posterior chain, pike push-ups for overhead shoulder strength, and plank holds to finish. Run this twice a week with at least two days between sessions and focus on crisp movement over rushing through.

messages.text: Two things - I want to permanently swap the core phase out of the full-body strength routine you just built me, going forward, my lower back doesn't handle it well, every time, not just today. And separately, can you restructure this week specifically - add a 20 minute mobility session on Saturday, just for this week.

paragraphs: Look, if your lower back does not agree with that core phase, we do not force it. I took the core phase out of the bodyweight full-body routine permanently. Your lower back health comes first, always. And for today, I locked in a 20-minute mobility session on your schedule to keep things loose without overloading anything. Focus on breathing and moving easy.

input.message: That's it for today, wrap this up.

output.reply: Good work today. We got the bodyweight routine dialed in, protected your back, and kept the week aligned. Take care of that mobility session today, stay loose, and rest up. Talk soon, champ.
